{{nihongo|'''Ubaihoumei Shrine'''|優婆夷宝明神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Izu Province]].

'''Ubaihōmei Shrine''' (うばいほうめいじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Hachijō, Tokyo|ar|هاتشيجو، طوكيو|arz|هاتشيجو, طوكيو|ca|Hachijō|ceb|Hachijō Machi|es|Hachijō (Tokio)|fa|هاچیجو، توکیو|fi|Hachijō (Tokio)|fr|Hachijō|hy|Հաթիձե (ավան)|id|Hachijō, Tōkyō|it|Hachijō|ja|八丈町|ko|하치조정|ms|Hachijō, Tokyo|my|ဟချိဂျေားမြို့၊ တိုကျို|ru|Хатидзё (посёлок)|th|ฮาจิโจ (โตเกียว)|tl|Hachijō, Tokyo|tr|Hachijō (kasaba)|uk|Хатідзьо (Токіо)|ur|ہاچی جو، ٹوکیو|zh|八丈町|zh_yue|八丈町|qid=Q1354815}} ({{ill|Hachijō-jima|ar|هاتشيجو-جيما|az|Haçicocima|ba|Хатидзё утрауы|ceb|Hachijō Jima|ckb|ھاچیجۆ-جیما|cs|Hačidžódžima|de|Hachijō-jima|es|Hachijōjima|fa|هاچیجوجیما|fr|Hachijō-jima|id|Hachijō-jima|it|Hachijō-jima|ja|八丈島|ko|하치조섬|lv|Hačidžjo|nl|Hachijojima|pnb|ہاچیجو-جیما|pt|Hachijo-jima|ru|Хатидзё (остров)|simple|Hachijō-jima|sk|Hačijódžima|sv|Hachijō-jima|tr|Hachijōjima|uk|Хатідзьо (острів)|vi|Hachijō-jima|wuu|八丈岛|zh|八丈島|zh_yue|八丈島|qid=Q1191120}}), {{ill|Tokyo|Q1490|qid=Q1490}}. It is the general tutelary shrine of Hachijō-jima and {{ill|Aogashima|ar|أوغاشيما|ast|Islla d'Aogashima|az|Aoqaşima|ceb|Aoga Shima|cs|Aogašima|de|Aogashima|es|Isla de Aogashima|fa|آئوگاشیما (جزیره)|fr|Aoga-shima|gl|Aogashima|id|Aogashima|ja|青ヶ島|ka|აოგაშიმა|ko|아오가섬|ku|Aogashima|nl|Aogashima|pt|Aogashima|ru|Аогасима (остров)|sk|Aogašima (ostrov)|sv|Aoga-shima|uk|Аоґасіма (острів)|xmf|აოგაშიმა|zh|青岛 (伊豆群岛)|zh_min_nan|Aogasima|qid=Q615578}}.

It was formed by merging the {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}} '''Ubainomikoto Shrine''' (うばいのみことじんじゃ) and '''Koshikinomikoto Shrine''' (こしきのみことじんじゃ). Its current name combines the names of the deities of those two shrines, described below<ref>[https://ubai-houmei.tokyo/ 優婆夷宝明神社] - official website</ref><ref name="yafune">[http://www.yafune.server-shared.com/you-xu/ 由緒] - Yafune Shrine</ref>.

=== Enshrined deities ===
* Ubai Ōkami (うばいのおおかみ) - one of the eight consorts, Yasoyaehime, of {{ill|Kotoshironushi-no-Mikoto|qid=Q8009611|lt=Kotoshironushi-no-Mikoto|qid=Q8009611}} (Mishima Daimyōjin)<ref name="jinjacho">[http://www.tokyo-jinjacho.or.jp/tosho/3142/ 優婆夷宝明神社] - Tokyo Association of Shinto Shrines</ref><ref name="jinjacho2">[http://tosho.tokyo-jinjacho.or.jp/hachijyoujima.html 優婆夷宝明神社] - Tokyo Association of Shinto Shrines (Island Special Edition)</ref>; i.e., Ubainomikoto, deity of the Shikinaisha Ubainomikoto Shrine<ref name="yafune"/>.
* Hōmei-no-Kami (ほうめいのかみ) - her child Kohōmaru<ref name="jinjacho"/><ref name="jinjacho2"/>; i.e., Koshikinomikoto, deity of the Shikinaisha Koshikinomikoto Shrine<ref name="yafune"/>.
